items.rationale: Sections 2.4.4 and 7.1.9 cover like-for-like renewal of the internal fitting fractured by frost. One valve at €52 gives €52 gross.
Section 7.1.9 covers connection elements that must be renewed with the fractured valve. One hose at €27 gives €27 gross.
Sections 7.1.7(f) and 7.1.9 cover the labour to renew the fitting. The gross prior for all three invoiced hours is €299.

Sections 7.1.7(e) and 7.1.9 cover consumables actually used in the repair, but this generic line does not distinguish those from excluded small equipment or site charges under 3.6. If substantiated as repair consumables, the single lot is estimated at €45 gross.
Sections 7.1.9 and 7.1.11 allow one attendance for the covered fitting repair. The closest same-wording references support €39 gross for the single visit.
Sections 2.4.6 and 5.2.2 expressly cover imaging equipment used to trace the escape. The single €17.60 gross charge is below the €2,500 leak-location cap.

items.description: Facade damage from internal water escape
items.rationale: Section 2.4.3 covers the damaged facade because water from the internal burst saturated the render before freezing; external-frost cover is not required. Under 7.1.12, the estimated €380 gross for one lump sum applies only if it prices distinct reinstatement work not billed elsewhere.
Section 7.1.7(a) covers removal of failed render from the area damaged by the internal escape under 2.4.3. One removal lot is estimated at €85 gross using the plaster-removal reference.
Sections 2.4.3 and 7.1.7(c)–(d) cover like-for-like rebuilding of the damaged render base. The gross prior for one invoiced unit is €38.

Sections 7.1.12 and 9.6 require the lump sum to identify work attributable to the covered damage, which this description does not do. If itemised as distinct covered repair work, the single lot is provisionally estimated at €90 gross.
Sections 2.4.3 and 7.1.7(c) cover preparation and re-forming of the substrate in the affected area. The gross prior for one invoiced unit is €31.
Section 7.1.7(d) covers the coats required by the like-for-like finish system on the facade area damaged under 2.4.3. The gross prior for the single four-coat line is €59.
Sections 2.4.3 and 7.1.7(c) cover necessary drying of the fabric saturated by the internal escape before reinstatement. The gross prior for one drying lot is €254.
Section 7.1.7(c)–(d) covers priming needed to restore the pre-loss finish on the affected facade area. The gross prior for one priming lot is €117.
Sections 2.4.3 and 7.1.7(f) cover labour to reinstate the facade damaged by the internal escape. The gross prior for all five invoiced hours is €277.

Sections 7.1.12 and 9.6 require a flat-rate line to identify covered work; an unspecified surcharge is not payable. If documented as a distinct covered repair task, the single lot is provisionally estimated at €75 gross.
